title: Descent of the tensor-route equality from K-flat models
statement: For the same explicit ordinary monoidal pullback data, an equality of the residue tensor-route and tensor-model maps on every homotopy complex whose ordinary pullback is K-flat descends, by naturality and essential surjectivity of the derived quotient, to the equality on every homotopy complex.

proof.text: Choose a K-flat pullback model and an isomorphism from its derived image to the given object. Use naturality of both composites and cancel the invertible image of the isomorphism.

proof_origin.document: Mathlib derived-category localization and existing K-flat model construction
proof_origin.place: Derived-category descent step of the tensor-route proof
proof_origin.note: Strictly separate from the tensor comparison calculation; it does not assert the route equation on its own.
